title: 4 Types of Contamination Removed in Semiconductor Cleaning: Particles, Organics, Metals, and Native Oxide
excerpt: Semiconductor cleaning removes 4 types of contamination: particles, organics, metals, and native oxide. Learn the basics of how each one causes harm and how each is removed, with worked calculations, in Lesson 2 of Cleaning Level 3. You can also review key terms and common misconceptions.
